meta.source: scripts/build-itaewon.mjs, at 1/4 on the real place: Itaewon-ro, Noksapyeong-daero, Bogwang-ro, Usadan-ro, Sinheung-ro, Sowol-ro, Seobinggo-ro and Gyeongnidan-gil (Hoenamu-ro) from OpenStreetMap (scripts/data/itaewon-osm.json, gyeongnidan-osm.json); Namsan with its cable car (scripts/build-namsan.mjs). The World Food Street, Yongmaru Market's lanes and every building and shop are made up; the museums are at the real 1/4.. The city wall on Namsan and Gwanghuimun: scripts/build-namsan-wall.mjs (OpenStreetMap, scripts/data/namsan-wall-osm.json)
